Preserve the master, section order, and existing title slide. Complete the unfinished slides with a concise executive summary, revenue and EBITDA bridges, business-unit scorecard, cash and working-capital view, backlog and outlook, forecast risks and opportunities, and management actions. Document the controlling sources inside the deliverable. Recalculate or render as appropriate and save to the exact target path. The file is graded.
